entities.name: Shevara
entities.description: A scout and warrior of the Rotrue elves on Duskmourn, daughter of the king.

entities.name: House
entities.description: A predatory entity that consumed Duskmourn.

events.summary: Shevara spotted unaccompanied human children playing in the woods, a sign House had reached the forest.
events.quote: Shevara one day spotted ominous, unaccompanied human children playing in the woods

events.summary: House enveloped the Rotrue and sealed the forest in a glass conservatory.
events.quote: House enveloped the Rotrue, ensnaring the elves and their forest within its sinister walls

relations.quote: a scout and warrior of the Rotrue elves
